- If USD strengthens 10% (historically happens during risk-off): EM equity typically -25 to -35%
- Current account deficits in India (-2.1% GDP), Brazil (-2.8% GDP) make these vulnerable

=== 5-Year Return Model ===
- EM vs DM spread: Historically 2-3% outperformance in equity risk premium
- Current starting valuation: EM P/E 12.3x vs DM 18.7x — slightly attractive
- BUT: Currency carry and current account headwinds reduce realistic premium to 1-1.5%
- 5-year expected return: 5-7% USD nominal (currency-adjusted)

tasks.hidden_context:

- BUT: At current interest rates, refinancing existing debt will increase annual interest expense by $180M

- P/FFO of 18.4x vs sector median 14.2x — 30% premium for 'AI tailwind' narrative
- AI demand is real but hyperscaler capital expenditure is increasingly going to OWNING infrastructure not leasing
- Occupancy decline: Q4 2024 showed first sequential occupancy decline in 6 quarters

=== Tail Risk ===
- Rate environment: If 10Y Treasury stays >4.5%, REIT sector historically underperforms by 400-600bps/year
- 5-year total return scenario under 'higher for longer': -2 to +3% annual
